event: Government bond (SUN) auction on 27 October drew bids of only Rp31.09 trillion, the lowest since November 2024, and the government absorbed Rp20.65 trillion against an indicative Rp30 trillion target as the roughly 10-year yield rose to 7.54%.

event: The IHSG closed 28 October up 0.31% at 5,282.31 after falling to about 5,170 at midday, ahead of the Fed decision and weak SUN auction demand. (update of E0350)
